result.summary: The landlord's reply (event 008) points to an isolator switch to the right of the hob, which probably explains why the extractor fan won't turn on. The landlord did not approve or decline a repair, so approval #5 stays pending and nothing has been booked. I emailed the tenant asking her to switch it on and tell us whether the fan works, and put the ticket on hold for 3 days.
result.situation: The tenant reported on 11 Sep that the kitchen extractor fan at Flat 1, 31 Juniper Mews won't turn on. On 13 Sep the agency asked the landlord whether to use their own contractor or one of ours. The tenant then replied 'Thank you!' (event 007). The landlord replied on 15 Sep that there is a switch to the right-hand side of the hob that needs to be switched on (event 008). Stage: landlord_approval, with approval #5 pending.
